name: calm-twitter
description: This extension hides trending information from twitter timelines to make your mind calm.

scripts.package: npm run build && npm run zip
scripts.zip: mkdir -p packages && cd dist && zip -r ../packages/calm-twitter-v$npm_package_version.zip . -x '**/.DS_Store' -x '__MACOSX/*' -x '.vite/*' && cd .. && echo 'Created packages/calm-twitter-v'$npm_package_version'.zip'
